# swift-tailscale-client

> Unofficial Swift 6 async/await client for the Tailscale LocalAPI: query and
> control an ALREADY-INSTALLED tailscaled daemon (status, peers, ping, prefs,
> DNS diagnostics, serve/Funnel with ETag concurrency, certificates, auth,
> real-time IPN-bus streaming). Not an embedded node (use TailscaleKit for
> that) and not the api.tailscale.com admin API. MIT; not affiliated with
> Tailscale Inc.

Dependency: `.package(url: "https://github.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client.git", from: "1.1.0")`
Platforms: macOS 13+ connects to daemons; iOS/tvOS/watchOS build only; Linux is unqualified. Swift 6.1+. The `TailscaleClient` library has no third-party dependencies (resolving the package also fetches swift-argument-parser for the CLI).
IPN bus: Tailscale 1.104+ rejects the `initialNetMap`/`rateLimit` watch options (the client drops them and retries) and sends no netmap; follow peers with `[.initialState, .peerChanges, .noNetMap]` and re-read `status()` per notification.

## Docs

- [Integration guide (canonical)](https://github.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client/blob/main/Documentation/INTEGRATING.md): usage patterns, gotchas, testing with mocks
- [Peer Diagnostics sample](https://github.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client/tree/main/Examples/PeerDiagnostics): runnable SwiftUI app with a fixture mode (no Tailscale needed) and a read-only live mode; shows ping-path classification, a bounded ping burst, staleness, and App Store discovery consent
- Ping path (1.1.0+): `PingResult.path` is `nil` on error, else `.peerRelay`, `.derp`, `.direct`, or `.unknown` (TSMP/ICMP/peerAPI pings); a failed ping returns normally rather than throwing. See gotcha 7 and the ping mock body under "Testing an app that uses this package" in the integration guide
- [Endpoint manifest (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client/main/Documentation/endpoints.json): machine-readable per-endpoint facts — symbol, read/write risk, feature gate, minimum tailscaled version, stability
- [API reference (DocC)](https://dweekly.github.io/swift-tailscale-client/documentation/tailscaleclient/): full symbol documentation and articles (Getting Started, Streaming, Writing Safely, Login Flow, Serve & Funnel) and recipes, including the Peer Diagnostics walkthrough
- [LocalAPI coverage](https://github.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client/blob/main/Documentation/LOCALAPI-COVERAGE.md): the package's position on every LocalAPI endpoint
- [README](https://github.com/dweekly/swift-tailscale-client/blob/main/README.md): tool choice (this package vs TailscaleKit vs admin API vs CLI), runtime support matrix
